top_signals.title: U.S. Open organizers facing fresh scrutiny over late-night finishes
top_signals.summary: The tension between spectacle and scheduling was laid bare again on Tuesday after a string of marathon contests pushed play deep into the early hours of Wednesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
